title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
statement:
Given the head of a linked list, remove the nth node from the end of the list and return the head of the modified list.

The removal should be done in a single pass through the list.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is sz

visibleExamples.explanation: Remove the second node from the end (node with value 4)
Remove the only node in the list

jsonFriendlyReason: The head parameter is a ListNode (linked list), which requires a custom adapter for JSON serialization.
